name: supplychain
description: Supply-chain security for JavaScript and Python projects — npm, pnpm, Yarn v2+, uv, pip, Poetry, pdm, and GitHub Actions CI. Router skill: detects which ecosystems a project uses and dispatches to the matching sub-skill under skills/. Read this first, then read only the sub-skill(s) the project actually needs.
